bolivia-national-2025.notes: Source 1 is the icpcbolivia.org site as of 2026 (belongs to bolivia-national-2026); it mentions the 2025 contest as 197 teams in eleven sites and a results post dated 2025-09-13 (blog/resultados-nacional-2025, not in our copy). Source 2 copy is a Gandi parking page, not the earlier reader's 2026 homepage.

sources.evidence: The site is the 2026 edition (Fase Nacional 1 and 2 of 2026, 2026 results and rules); the 2025 contest appears only in passing mentions on the about page, a gallery caption and a blog index entry whose page is not in our copy.
The copy is a registrar parking page reading 'This domain name has been registered with Gandi.net ... icpcbolivia.org is unavailable'.

bolivia-national-2026.notes: The site is a multi-phase national contest (Phase 1 29 Aug, Phase 2 19 Sep 2026); the pack has no single date. The same crawl is also filed under bolivia-national-2025 and its pages mention 2025. Spanish page text includes sponsor and contact e-mail addresses (not repeated).

sources.evidence: The crawled site is titled Competencia Boliviana de Programación 2026, with results pages for Fase Nacional 1 and 2 of 2026 and the 2026 rules PDF.
The home page is headed Competencia Boliviana de Programación 2026 with Fase Nacional 1 on 29 Aug and Fase Nacional 2 on 19 Sep.
